title: Born-Infeld AdS Black Holes Surrounded by Perfect Fluid Dark Matter
summary: We obtain exact charged AdS black hole solutions in Einstein Lambda gravity including the effects of Born Infeld nonlinear electrodynamics and Perfect Fluid Dark Matter. The influence of the PFDM and BI parameters on the event horizon is analyzed. We compute the conserved and thermodynamic quantities and verify that they satisfy the first law of thermodynamics. Thermal stability is studied in the canonical ensemble using the heat capacity and Helmholtz free energy showing how PFDM and BI parameters affect local and global stability regions.
